7.4 Supervision Modes
Expected execution (timing or sequence) of the Software can change based on certain
conditions. Hence, the value of the Supervision (Alive/Deadline/Logical) parameters
might have to be changed based on conditions. For each such condition a mode called
a
Supervision Mode
can be configured. Currently, this condition can be configured
based on
Function Group
State.
